Absolute Fencing Gear supplies the strips and scoring machines and will be on site to sell and repair equipment, handy if a blade breaks. Check the time listed for each event: at USA Fencing tournaments it is usually when check-in closes, not when fencing starts.

body: At a big tournament, being late to the strip costs touches. Before a pool or the direct-elimination round, the referee's first call comes ten minutes before the start; a fencer who isn't there is eliminated (t.118). Once fencing is under way, a fencer not ready when called gets a Yellow Card. One minute later comes a second call and a Red Card, which adds a touch to the opponent's score. A third call a minute after that means elimination (t.119). Bring a spare weapon, body cord and mask cord to the strip, too (t.117).
